scope.description: Qualified new-organization lead for the owner-named 123 Cyber deep dossier, with Canadian identity, three concrete offerings, independent program and partner proof, and explicit evidence limits.

source.title: 123 Cyber | Cybersecurity Risk Management
source.locator: Compliance Solutions, Services, and Our Integrated Tools sections
source.summary: The official site describes 123 Cyber's defence-supplier governance, risk and compliance services and its AuditPrep, Capture and Enclave tools.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official product portfolio corroborated by Corporations Canada, Vimy Forge, ThinkOn, Calian, National Defence, ACOA, PSPC and CSE.
followUpQuestions: Which supported hardware, accreditation boundary and synchronization controls define deployable 123 Capture configurations?
Which 123 Enclave controls remain the responsibility of 123 Cyber, ThinkOn and the customer during CPCSC or CMMC preparation?
Where does 123 AuditPrep preparation and validation end before an accredited CPCSC Level 2 assessment begins?
reviewWarnings: 123 Capture sources do not disclose performance benchmarks, supported hardware, accreditation status or the boundaries of reported Army and Navy use.
123 Enclave sources do not allocate every compliance control responsibility or establish 123 Cyber as an accredited CPCSC assessor.
Public sources do not establish exhaustive customers, contract values, financing or a complete current operating-ownership structure.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: The official sitemap and product pages resolved identity, contact, three named tools, services, partners and current company positioning.
Corporations Canada confirmed active legal identity, corporation number, incorporation date and current annual filings without proving the complete operating ownership story.
The bilingual ACOA announcement confirmed Montreal identity and selection into Vimy Forge's first Canadian defence-innovation cohort.
Independent ThinkOn, Vimy Forge and Calian partner pages corroborated Enclave delivery, Capture military-use context and Calian VENTURES participation.
Vimy Forge recovered offline, on-device, synchronization and reported Army and Navy use details; no performance benchmarks or accreditation boundary was published.
French and English government searches confirmed the CPCSC rollout and defence-supply-chain rationale without adding a 123 Cyber contract or accreditation claim.
The Canadian Cybersecurity Network directory added only a broad listing-level managed-services description that was not used without stronger official corroboration.
The final CIPO search confirmed a live 2026 trademark application but added no customer, deployment, performance or product-availability evidence.
The final DEFSEC directory check confirmed exhibitor visibility only and added no material capability, contract, relationship or reviewer-action claim.

leads.roleSpecificEvidence: The company presents three independently reviewable offerings: AuditPrep compliance workflow software, Capture offline voice-to-structured-data processing, and Enclave Canadian sovereign-cloud collaboration, with independent Vimy Forge, ThinkOn and Calian proof.
